crossRefs.note: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.
Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now…
Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the…
but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land…
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

translations.web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
translations.bsb: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
translations.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
translations.asv: Length of days is in her right hand; In her left hand are riches and honor.
